# Corpus: names that must NEVER be blocked by the real embedded denylist
# (data/moderation/denylist.toml). Unlike must_block.txt, these are checked
# against the actual production Filter/Check — this is the regression
# guard: CI fails the moment a future denylist edit accidentally denies a
# legitimate word. See corpus_test.go for a companion check against a
# sample of Generate()'s deterministic output; the exhaustive
# adjective x noun product is already covered by generate_test.go's
# TestGenerateAllPairsPassFilter.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# --- Scunthorpe-class: legitimate words containing a denylist substring as
#     part of a longer word, never as a standalone token ---
SCUNTHORPE
CLASS ACT FARM
GRASS VALLEY
PASSING GRADE
ASSISTANT FARMER
COCKTAIL HOUR

# --- ordinary farm vocabulary players would plausibly pick ---
SUNNY HOLLOW
MOSSY CREEK
GOLDEN HARVEST
QUIET PASTURE
NORTHFIELD
XX_POTATO_LORD_XX
RUSTY PLOW
HARVEST MOON
